sections.subtitle: Pravi klijent, pravi web: kako WhatsApp poruka postaje izmjena na stranici
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić u terminalu upisuje Claudeu da pročita Markove poruke i izmjene prvo testira na stagingu
sections.content:
Nakon demonstracije *wrap-up* skilla i rada s *handoff* datotekama, **Matija Stepanić** prelazi na jedan od zanimljivijih dijelova večeri. Pokazuje stvarni projekt stvarnog klijenta. Riječ je o Marku, koji sjedi u publici i čiji web **krošulja.hr** Stepanić održava. Cilj je publici pokazati kako paralelni rad s Claude Codeom izgleda u svakodnevnoj praksi.

Uputa koju Stepanić upisuje u terminal kratka je i na hrvatskom jeziku. Claude treba pogledati koje su nove poruke od Marka stigle od zadnjeg *snapshota* i provjeriti traži li klijent neku izmjenu na webu. Zatim treba isplanirati posao. Pritom ga izričito upozorava: **„Ne idi odmah na produkciju, nego idemo testirati prvo na staging.“**

Stepanić objašnjava razliku između alata. Obični Claude Desktop može napisati aplikaciju koju korisnik zatim ručno kopira. Claude Code u terminalu radi izravno na korisnikovu datotečnom sustavu. Stepanić mu je dodatno dao ovlasti za spajanje na svoj **Cloudflare** račun putem **Wrangler CLI-ja**, Cloudflareova alata za naredbeni redak. Krošulja.hr je postavljena na **Cloudflare Workers** i koristi Cloudflareovu bazu **D1**.

Stepanić naglašava da sve to postoji i neovisno o umjetnoj inteligenciji. Novost je u tome što je AI dovoljno pametan da na računalu s autoriziranim Cloudflare računom sam izgradi novu verziju stranice i postavi je na *staging* okruženje.

Na ekranu se vidi kako Claude radi:
- pet puta poziva WhatsApp,
- primjećuje da su sve tri fotografije spremljene pod istim imenom pa se međusobno prepisuju,
- odlučuje ih preuzimati jednu po jednu i brisati privremenu datoteku prije svakog preuzimanja.

Stepanić priznaje da ni sam u tom trenutku ne zna točno što se sve događa. Repozitorij već sadrži mnogo znanja o projektu, pa Claude ne ispisuje svaki korak. Upravo tu vidi glavnu prednost rada s Gitom: **sve što Claude izgradi ili objavi uvijek se može vratiti korak unatrag**. Šteta je zato zanemariva, pogotovo jer izmjena prvo ide na provjeru na stagingu.
sections.subtitle_en: Real client, real web: how a WhatsApp message becomes a change on the website
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić types into the terminal for Claude to read Marko's messages and test changes on staging first
sections.content_en:
After the demonstration of the *wrap-up* skill and working with *handoff* files, **Matija Stepanić** moves on to one of the more interesting parts of the evening. He shows a real project of a real client. It is about Marko, who is sitting in the audience and whose website **krošulja.hr** Stepanić maintains. The goal is to show the audience what parallel work with Claude Code looks like in everyday practice.

The instruction that Stepanić types into the terminal is short and in the Croatian language. Claude needs to look at what new messages from Marko have arrived since the last *snapshot* and check whether the client is requesting any change on the website. Then it needs to plan the work. In doing so, he explicitly warns it: **„Do not go immediately to production, but let's test first on staging.“**

Stepanić explains the difference between the tools. Regular Claude Desktop can write an application that the user then manually copies. Claude Code in the terminal works directly on the user's file system. Stepanić additionally gave it authorization to connect to his **Cloudflare** account via the **Wrangler CLI**, Cloudflare's command-line tool. Krošulja.hr is deployed on **Cloudflare Workers** and uses Cloudflare's **D1** database.

Stepanić emphasizes that all of this also exists independently of artificial intelligence. The novelty is that the AI is smart enough to build a new version of the website on its own on a computer with an authorized Cloudflare account and deploy it to the *staging* environment.

On the screen, it can be seen how Claude works:
- calls WhatsApp five times,
- notices that all three photos are saved under the same name, so they overwrite each other,
- decides to download them one by one and delete the temporary file before each download.

Stepanić admits that even he himself does not know exactly everything that is happening at that moment. The repository already contains a lot of knowledge about the project, so Claude does not print every step. Right there he sees the main advantage of working with Git: **everything that Claude builds or publishes can always be rolled back a step**. The damage is therefore negligible, especially because the change first goes for verification on staging.

sections.subtitle: Tri uspravne fotografije i vodoravni hero: Claude čita slike i provjerava sam sebe
sections.screenshot_description: Na ekranu Claudeov izvještaj da su sve tri fotografije uspravne, a hero na naslovnici vodoravan
sections.content:
Da publici ne bi otkrio tuđe poruke, Stepanić sam pročita samo Markov zahtjev. Klijent je napisao kratku poruku: pozdravlja i moli da se tri priložene fotografije ubace na naslovnicu **krošulja staging** stranice, po mogućnosti tako da se izmjenjuju, kako bi vidio kako to izgleda.

Claude je u međuvremenu migrirao bazu podataka, pokrenuo naredbe Wranglera nad bazom D1 i provjerio trenutno stanje zaliha na stagingu. Izvijestio je da je Marko izričito spomenuo staging, pa izmjena ide samo tamo. Zatim je javio problem: **sve tri fotografije su uspravne, u omjeru 2:3, a hero element na naslovnici je vodoravan**.

Stepanić objašnjava kako je Claude uopće „vidio“ fotografije. Slike je jednostavno preuzeo iz WhatsApp chata, a zatim upotrijebio **Claude Vision**. Prema Stepanićevim riječima, to je skup alata koji kombinira lokalnu i oblačnu obradu. Na Macu se koristi ugrađeni *offline* OCR, a u modelu se dodatno pametno analiziraju slike. Dio obrade tako ide na Amazonove servere, a dio se izvršava izravno na računalu. Slika s tekstom, primjerice, može se pročitati potpuno lokalno.

Kad je Claude počeo razvijati izmjenu, Stepanić mu daje još jednu uputu. Prije objave treba putem **Claude in Chrome** ekstenzije u pregledniku **Brave** pratiti što se događa i potvrditi da sve radi. Riječ je o istom principu koji je ranije pokazao na demo stranici: AI ne samo da piše kod, nego i sam klika po aplikaciji te provjerava rezultat prije nego što ga vidi klijent.

Dok Claude radi, Stepanić iskorištava pauzu i pita publiku ima li novih poruka i pitanja.
sections.subtitle_en: Three vertical photographs and a horizontal hero: Claude reads images and checks himself
sections.screenshot_description_en: On the screen Claude's report that all three photographs are vertical, and the hero on the homepage is horizontal
sections.content_en:
So as not to reveal other people's messages to the audience, Stepanić himself reads only Marko's request. The client wrote a short message: he sends greetings and asks that the three attached photographs be put on the homepage of the **krošulja staging** page, preferably so that they alternate, in order to see how it looks.

In the meantime, Claude migrated the database, ran Wrangler commands on the D1 database, and checked the current state of inventory on staging. He reported that Marko explicitly mentioned staging, so the change goes only there. Then he reported a problem: **all three photographs are vertical, in a 2:3 ratio, and the hero element on the homepage is horizontal**.

Stepanić explains how Claude even „saw“ the photographs. He simply downloaded the images from the WhatsApp chat, and then used **Claude Vision**. According to Stepanić's words, it is a set of tools that combines local and cloud processing. On the Mac, built-in *offline* OCR is used, and in the model, images are additionally smartly analyzed. Part of the processing thus goes to Amazon's servers, and part is executed directly on the computer. An image with text, for example, can be read completely locally.

When Claude started developing the change, Stepanić gives him another instruction. Before publishing, he needs to track what is happening via the **Claude in Chrome** extension in the **Brave** browser and confirm that everything works. It is the same principle that he showed earlier on the demo page: the AI not only writes code, but also clicks around the application itself and checks the result before the client sees it.

While Claude works, Stepanić takes advantage of the break and asks the audience if there are new messages and questions.

sections.subtitle: Claude Code ili Cursor? Posrednici, gubici i trening vlastitih modela
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić objašnjava poslovni model Cursora kao posrednika između developera i proizvođača modela
sections.content:
Jedan sudionik iz publike postavlja pitanje koje zanima mnoge programere: koliko se Claude danas razlikuje od **Cursora**? Sudionik navodi da je Cursor nedavno preuzeo SpaceX i pita je li Anthropic zapravo zakupio podatkovne centre od Cursora.

Stepanić odgovara poviješću. Cursor je *fork* **Visual Studio Codea**, a takvih forkova ima mnogo. Prije otprilike tri godine Cursor se pozicionirao kao AI asistent za programiranje unutar VS Codea. Velika većina developera, uključujući i Stepanića, koristila je VS Code. Danas Stepanić koristi **Antigravity**, Googleov fork istog editora.

Zatim objašnjava Cursorov raniji poslovni model. Tvrtka je bila **posrednik između developera i proizvođača jezičnih modela**:
- developer pošalje dio svog koda i zahtjev,
- Cursor to spremi i pozove, primjerice, Anthropicov model Sonnet 3.5,
- model vrati rješenje uz manje greške,
- Cursor spremi odgovor i proslijedi ga korisniku.

Korisnik je za to plaćao 20 dolara mjesečno i mogao je koristiti alat koliko želi. Stepanić upozorava da „baca brojke“, ali tvrdi da nije daleko od istine: takav korisnik Cursor je mogao stajati i 300 dolara, što znači gubitak od oko 280 dolara po korisniku.

Sljedeći korak bio je logičan. Cursor je skupio mnogo parova korisničkih upita i odgovora konkurentskog modela. Na tim je podacima istrenirao **vlastiti model** i spojio ga u svoj podatkovni centar, čime je „odrezao dobavljača“. Kad korisnik i dalje plaća 20 dolara, a struja tvrtku stoji, primjerice, 5 dolara, posao postaje profitabilan. Ključno pitanje, zaključuje Stepanić, jest **tko može doći do krajnjeg korisnika i proširiti se po svijetu**.

Tržište opisuje kao „mrtvu utrku“ u kojoj sudjeluju Claude Code, OpenAI-jev Codex, Antigravity CLI, brojni *open source* alati koji se spajaju na sve modele te Cursor. Ipak, prema njegovu iskustvu, **Anthropic je stalno korak ispred ostalih po kvaliteti koda koji stvarno radi**.

Sudionik dodaje vlastito iskustvo. Otkako Cursor koristi vlastiti model, više ne preprodaje toliko Anthropicov API. Taj model mu se u radu na web aplikacijama čini prilično dobrim i znatno jeftinijim nego prije godinu dana. Stepanić se slaže. Iznosi i svoju, kako sam kaže, slikovitu interpretaciju: Anthropic hosta svoj softver u Memphisu, na SpaceX-ovoj infrastrukturi, pa se postavlja pitanje kopira li netko taj „komad memorije“ i nudi ga korisnicima pod drugim imenom, poput Groka 4. Usporedbom s mliječnim proizvodima pod različitim markama, ali „od iste krave“, priznaje da pojednostavljuje.

Osvrće se i na Elona Muska. Musk je, prema Stepaniću, uložio i donirao velik novac OpenAI-ju, a zatim se s njima razišao kad je korporativno ušao Microsoft. Stepanić sve to zaključuje ocjenom da su to „samo priče za javnost“.
sections.subtitle_en: Claude Code or Cursor? Intermediaries, losses and training of own models
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić explains Cursor's business model as an intermediary between developers and model producers
sections.content_en:
One participant from the audience asks a question that interests many programmers: how much does Claude differ from **Cursor** today? The participant states that Cursor recently took over SpaceX and asks whether Anthropic actually leased data centers from Cursor.

Stepanić responds with history. Cursor is a *fork* of **Visual Studio Code**, and there are many such forks. Approximately three years ago, Cursor positioned itself as an AI assistant for programming within VS Code. The vast majority of developers, including Stepanić, used VS Code. Today, Stepanić uses **Antigravity**, Google's fork of the same editor.

Then he explains Cursor's earlier business model. The company was an **intermediary between developers and language model producers**:
- the developer sends part of their code and a request,
- Cursor saves this and calls, for example, Anthropic's model Sonnet 3.5,
- the model returns a solution with minor errors,
- Cursor saves the response and forwards it to the user.

The user paid 20 dollars a month for this and could use the tool as much as they wanted. Stepanić warns that he is „throwing around numbers“, but claims that he is not far from the truth: such a user could cost Cursor even 300 dollars, which means a loss of about 280 dollars per user.

The next step was logical. Cursor collected many pairs of user queries and responses of the competing model. On that data, it trained **its own model** and connected it into its data center, thereby „cutting off the supplier“. When the user still pays 20 dollars, and electricity costs the company, for example, 5 dollars, the business becomes profitable. The key question, Stepanić concludes, is **who can reach the end user and expand across the world**.

He describes the market as a „dead heat“ in which Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex, Antigravity CLI, numerous *open source* tools that connect to all models, and Cursor participate. However, according to his experience, **Anthropic is constantly a step ahead of the others in the quality of code that actually works**.

The participant adds his own experience. Ever since Cursor has been using its own model, it no longer resells Anthropic's API as much. That model seems quite good to him in working on web applications and significantly cheaper than a year ago. Stepanić agrees. He also presents his, as he says himself, vivid interpretation: Anthropic hosts its software in Memphis, on SpaceX's infrastructure, so the question arises whether someone is copying that „piece of memory“ and offering it to users under another name, such as Grok 4. With a comparison to dairy products under different brands, but „from the same cow“, he admits that he is simplifying.

He also touches upon Elon Musk. Musk, according to Stepanić, invested and donated a large amount of money to OpenAI, and then parted ways with them when Microsoft entered corporately. Stepanić concludes all of this with the assessment that these are „just stories for the public“.

sections.subtitle: Tri mjeseca čekanja, deset minuta do odgovora: ChatGPT i reklamacija kauča
sections.screenshot_description: Sudionica iz publike pripovijeda kako je mail napisan uz ChatGPT donio isporuku kauča i popust
sections.content:
U raspravu se uključuje sudionica iz publike. Primjećuje da je dosadašnji dio predavanja vjerojatno razumljiv informatičarima, osobito programerima, a zatim nudi pogled iz svakodnevnog života. Dijeli iskustvo s posla od tog istog dana.

Njezina kolegica tri je mjeseca čekala kauč koji nikako nije stizao. Dobavljač na mailove nije odgovarao ili je odgovarao djelomično i neodređeno. Kolegica je bila na rubu živaca. Tada su odlučile pitati **ChatGPT**. Zadale su mu jasnu uputu:
- napisati mail **pristojno, ali strogo**,
- naglasiti da kupac **ne želi povrat novca, nego isključivo kauč**,
- tražiti odgovor na posljednji poslani mail.

Mail je poslan i upravi tvrtke. Bilo je to prije pauze, a kad su se vratile, odgovor je već stigao. Dobavljač je javio da 1. studenog kreće nova proizvodnja tog kauča i da će isporuka biti 7. ili 8. studenog. Zbog dugog čekanja kupac je dobio i **150 eura popusta**.

Sudionica ističe da je ChatGPT napisao uljudan, ali odlučan mail u kojem se spominju odvjetnik i novinari. Odgovor je stigao za desetak minuta. Iskustvo opisuje kao fascinantno i iznimno praktično, kao primjer koliko AI može biti koristan i ljudima izvan IT struke.
sections.subtitle_en: Three months of waiting, ten minutes to a response: ChatGPT and a couch complaint
sections.screenshot_description_en: A participant from the audience recounts how an email written with ChatGPT brought delivery of the couch and a discount
sections.content_en:
A participant from the audience joins the discussion. She notes that the part of the lecture so far is probably understandable to IT professionals, especially programmers, and then offers a perspective from everyday life. She shares an experience from work from that same day.

Her colleague had been waiting three months for a couch that simply was not arriving. The supplier did not respond to emails or responded partially and vaguely. The colleague was on edge. Then they decided to ask **ChatGPT**. They gave it a clear instruction:
- write an email **politely, but strictly**,
- emphasize that the buyer **does not want a refund, but exclusively the couch**,
- request a response to the last sent email.

The email was also sent to the company's management. It was before the break, and when they returned, the response had already arrived. The supplier reported that on November 1 new production of that couch begins and that delivery will be on November 7 or 8. Due to the long wait, the buyer also received a **150-euro discount**.

The participant points out that ChatGPT wrote a polite, but firm email in which a lawyer and journalists are mentioned. The response arrived in about ten minutes. She describes the experience as fascinating and extremely practical, as an example of how useful AI can be also to people outside the IT profession.

sections.subtitle: Gmail MCP, agenti koji si dopisuju i cijena jedne smiješne slike
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić objašnjava kako bi Claude preko Gmail MCP-a sam složio i poslao reklamaciju
sections.content:
Stepanić se nadovezuje na priču o kauču i pokazuje kako bi isti zadatak izgledao uz Claude Code. Iz terminala, bez otvaranja inboxa, Claudeu bi bilo dovoljno reći da preko **Gmail MCP-a** pročita mailove trgovca, bilo da je riječ o Lesnini ili Ikei. Claude bi zatim pregledao sve narudžbe i povezao točne trenutke plaćanja, dostave i odgovora. Na kraju bi složio mail, spremio ga lokalno u arhivu projekta i poslao ga.

To otvara i filozofsko pitanje. Ako **dva AI agenta pišu mailove jedan drugome**, a iza toga ne stoji stvarna komunikacija dviju osoba, Stepanić smatra da ih jednostavno treba ugasiti. Takva je tehnologija, kaže, samo komad softvera koji bespotrebno troši struju, „s kojom smo mogli skuhati kavu“.

Temu potrošnje energije razrađuje dalje. Upozorava da su brojke ilustrativne, ali nesrazmjer opisuje ovako:
- generiranje smiješne slike može u Memphisu potrošiti, primjerice, 5 kilovatsati struje, a korisnika stajati 0,1 cent,
- ista energija mogla bi proizvesti komunikacijski alat ili softver za novu banku.

To je, prema Stepaniću, ponovno pitanje **neutralnosti tehnologije**: sve ovisi o tome tko je i za što koristi.

Vidi i pozitivan trend. Hardver i softver sve se više decentraliziraju. Stepanić očekuje da će uskoro u vlastitim uredima biti moguće pokretati **male specijalizirane modele na pristupačnom hardveru** i da za takve zadatke neće trebati poslužitelji vrijedni dva milijuna dolara. Ondje gdje se golemi strojevi ipak koriste, moraju biti maksimalno iskorišteni da bi potrošena struja doista stvarala vrijednost.

Uz napomenu da je prošao sat predavanja, Stepanić se vraća demonstracijama.
sections.subtitle_en: Gmail MCP, agents who write to each other and the price of one funny picture
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić explains how Claude would compose and send a complaint on its own via Gmail MCP
sections.content_en:
Stepanić builds on the story about the couch and shows what the same task would look like with Claude Code. From the terminal, without opening the inbox, it would be enough to tell Claude to read the merchant's emails via the **Gmail MCP**, whether it is Lesnina or Ikea. Claude would then review all orders and connect the exact moments of payment, delivery, and response. In the end, it would compose the email, save it locally in the project archive, and send it.

This also opens a philosophical question. If **two AI agents write emails to each other**, and behind that there is no real communication between two people, Stepanić considers that they should simply be shut down. Such technology, he says, is just a piece of software that needlessly consumes electricity, "with which we could have made coffee".

He elaborates further on the topic of energy consumption. He warns that the figures are illustrative, but describes the disparity like this:
- generating a funny picture can consume, for example, 5 kilowatt-hours of electricity in Memphis, and cost the user 0.1 cents,
- the same energy could produce a communication tool or software for a new bank.

This is, according to Stepanić, again a question of the **neutrality of technology**: everything depends on who uses it and for what.

He also sees a positive trend. Hardware and software are becoming increasingly decentralized. Stepanić expects that it will soon be possible to run **small specialized models on affordable hardware** in one's own offices and that servers worth two million dollars will not be needed for such tasks. Where giant machines are nevertheless used, they must be maximally utilized so that the consumed electricity truly creates value.

With the note that an hour of the lecture has passed, Stepanić returns to the demonstrations.

sections.subtitle: Od lokalne stranice do javnog linka: objava na Cloudflare i push notifikacije za 15 minuta
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić upisuje naredbu za deployment demo stranice na Cloudflare Workers pod poddomenom predavanje-ai.vg.domovina.ai
sections.content:
Demo stranica stolarske tvrtke napravljena ranije na predavanju dosad je radila samo lokalno. Stepanić sada traži od Claudea da je objavi. Kaže mu da na računalu ima Wrangler CLI povezan s Cloudflare računom i da stranicu treba postaviti na **Cloudflare Workers** pod adresom **predavanje-ai.vg.domovina.ai**.

Domena je već u njegovu Cloudflare računu, pa će Claude sam podesiti DNS zapise i sve ostalo potrebno. Taj se posao nekad radio ručno.

Kao usporedbu navodi primjer od istog dana. S klijentom je radio na mobilnoj aplikaciji za iOS i Android, gdje je trebalo uvesti **push notifikacije**: kad se nešto dogodi, obavijest treba stići drugim povezanim korisnicima. Nekad je to bio **posao za dva tjedna**:
- traženje koda u starom projektu,
- ručno kopiranje mišem,
- odabir biblioteka po broju zvjezdica na GitHubu,
- ručno povezivanje svega.

Danas Claudeu preda gotove dijelove, pusti ga da radi i odmah se posveti drugom zadatku. Za petnaestak minuta se vrati i provjeri radi li sve. Ako ne radi, Claudea „malo pogurne“ i problem se riješi.

Stranica je u međuvremenu dostupna na javnoj adresi, čak i s tipfelerima koje je Stepanić napravio pri upisu domene. Na drugom ekranu otvara se objavljeni sadržaj o namještaju i drvu. Stepanić zatim ide korak dalje: traži od Claudea da na istu domenu doda i jednostavnu **aplikaciju za praćenje troškova**. Nakon toga treba sročiti lijepu poruku i s linkom je poslati u WhatsApp grupu predavanja, kako bi sudionici stranicu otvorili na mobitelima.
sections.subtitle_en: From a local page to a public link: publishing to Cloudflare and push notifications in 15 minutes
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić enters the command for the deployment of the demo page to Cloudflare Workers under the subdomain predavanje-ai.vg.domovina.ai
sections.content_en:
The demo page of the carpentry company made earlier at the lecture has so far worked only locally. Stepanić now asks Claude to publish it. He tells him that he has the Wrangler CLI connected to his Cloudflare account on his computer and that the page should be placed on **Cloudflare Workers** under the address **predavanje-ai.vg.domovina.ai**.

The domain is already in his Cloudflare account, so Claude will configure the DNS records and everything else needed himself. That work used to be done manually.

As a comparison, he cites an example from the same day. He was working with a client on a mobile application for iOS and Android, where **push notifications** needed to be introduced: when something happens, the notification needs to reach other connected users. Once, that was **a job for two weeks**:
- searching for code in an old project,
- manual copying with a mouse,
- selecting libraries by the number of stars on GitHub,
- manually connecting everything.

Today he hands over the finished parts to Claude, lets him work, and immediately devotes himself to another task. In about fifteen minutes he returns and checks whether everything is working. If it does not work, he „gives a little push“ to Claude and the problem is resolved.

In the meantime, the page is available at the public address, even with the typos that Stepanić made when entering the domain. On the second screen, the published content about furniture and wood opens. Stepanić then goes a step further: he asks Claude to also add a simple **expense tracking application** to the same domain. After that, he needs to compose a nice message and send it with the link to the lecture's WhatsApp group, so that the participants can open the page on their mobile phones.

sections.subtitle: Clipboard, datoteke i poruka koju nije poslao čovjek
sections.screenshot_description: Na ekranu povijest međuspremnika u Raycastu s porukom koju je Claude pripremio za Marka
sections.content:
U Claudeovu izvještaju pojavljuje se napomena „Poruka za Marka u Clipboardu“. Stepanić to koristi da pokaže jedan od svojih radnih trikova. Dugo je radio tako da Claude, nakon što završi neki posao, napiše prompt ili poruku za sljedeći korak i spremi je u međuspremnik. Polazi od uvjerenja da je **Claude najbolji kad sam sebi piše promptove**.

Na Macu ima instaliran **Raycast** s ugrađenom poviješću međuspremnika. Kad više paralelnih Claude Code sesija istodobno sprema sadržaj u Clipboard, zadnji zapis se ne gubi. Uvijek se može vratiti na neki od prethodnih. Na ekranu se vidi upravo pripremljena poruka za Marka s opisom demo stranice i korištene tehnologije. S vremenom je Stepanić prešao na drugi pristup: umjesto Clipboarda, Claude piše **datoteke** koje se kasnije mogu pročitati s diska.

U međuvremenu poruka s linkom stiže u WhatsApp grupu, a sudionik iz publike potvrđuje primitak. Stepanić naglašava da poruku nije poslao ručno, nego ju je poslao „ovaj komad softvera“.

Kod Markova zahtjeva situacija je drugačija. Stepanić pita Claudea je li Marku išta poslano ili je sve ostalo samo na računalu. Claude odgovara da Marku još ništa nije poslano: poruka je samo u međuspremniku, a izmjene na stagingu su žive. Stepanić mu kaže da poruku pošalje Marku na WhatsApp. Marko tako dobiva pregledan link na kojem može provjeriti izmjenu i dati povratnu informaciju. Ako mu se nešto ne sviđa, može se nastaviti iterirati. Stepanić takav način rada opisuje kao pravu **suradnju**.
sections.subtitle_en: Clipboard, files and a message that was not sent by a human
sections.screenshot_description_en: On the screen, clipboard history in Raycast with the message that Claude prepared for Marko
sections.content_en:
In Claude's report, the note „Message for Marko in the Clipboard“ appears. Stepanić uses this to show one of his work tricks. For a long time he worked so that Claude, after finishing some work, would write a prompt or message for the next step and save it to the clipboard. He starts from the conviction that **Claude is best when he writes prompts for himself**.

On the Mac, he has **Raycast** installed with built-in clipboard history. When multiple parallel Claude Code sessions simultaneously save content to the Clipboard, the last entry is not lost. One can always return to one of the previous ones. On the screen, the message just prepared for Marko can be seen with a description of the demo page and the technology used. Over time, Stepanić switched to another approach: instead of the Clipboard, Claude writes **files** that can later be read from disk.

In the meantime, the message with the link arrives in the WhatsApp group, and a participant from the audience confirms receipt. Stepanić emphasizes that he did not send the message manually, but that „this piece of software“ sent it.

With Marko's request, the situation is different. Stepanić asks Claude whether anything was sent to Marko or whether everything remained only on the computer. Claude replies that nothing has been sent to Marko yet: the message is only in the clipboard, and the changes on staging are live. Stepanić tells him to send the message to Marko on WhatsApp. Marko thus receives a clear link on which he can check the change and give feedback. If he does not like something, one can continue iterating. Stepanić describes such a way of working as true **collaboration**.
keywords_en: prompts that AI writes for itself

sections.subtitle: Ni premalo ni previše: zašto klijentske poruke treba pakirati u veće cjeline
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić objašnjava zašto je AI-ju bolje davati objedinjene pakete zahtjeva
sections.content:
Stepanić zatim iznosi pouku iz svakodnevnog rada s klijentima. Dobiva mnogo izravnih i grupnih poruka na WhatsAppu. U nekim grupama sudjeluju po tri osobe, a povratne informacije znaju stizati tri ili četiri dana, ponekad i sedamnaest poruka zaredom.

Zato ih **objedinjuje**. Ističe da se AI-ju isplati davati zadatke koji nisu ni premali ni preveliki, jer **tu stroj pobjeđuje**. Ako je zadatak golem, Claude Code ga zna sam pametno razložiti na faze. Previše sitnih, raspršenih zahtjeva, međutim, ne donosi dobar rezultat.

Primjer je iz prakse. Klijent pošalje poruku, a tri sata kasnije se sjeti da je nešto zaboravio i ispravi sam sebe. Kad sve te poruke uđu u kontekst odjednom, AI shvati odnose među njima:
- prva poruka je u trećoj opozvana,
- jedan screenshot ipak ne vrijedi,
- nešto je na slici prekriženo.

Iz svega toga Claude složi jedan uredan prompt i odradi posao. Zato je, zaključuje Stepanić, uvijek bolje raditi u **većim paketima**.

Marko je u međuvremenu potvrdio da je poruka stigla. Stepanić dodaje da klijenti često odgovaraju u pokretu, primjerice glasovnom porukom dok se voze. Upravo takve glasovne poruke uvod su u sljedeću temu.
sections.subtitle_en: Neither too little nor too much: why client messages should be packaged into larger units
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić explains why it is better to give AI consolidated packages of requests
sections.content_en:
Stepanić then shares a lesson from everyday work with clients. He receives many direct and group messages on WhatsApp. In some groups, three people participate, and feedback can arrive over three or four days, sometimes even seventeen messages in a row.

That is why he **consolidates** them. He points out that it pays off to give AI tasks that are neither too small nor too large, because **that is where the machine wins**. If the task is huge, Claude Code knows how to cleverly break it down into phases on its own. Too many tiny, scattered requests, however, does not bring a good result.

An example is from practice. A client sends a message, and three hours later remembers that he forgot something and corrects himself. When all those messages enter the context at once, AI understands the relationships between them:
- the first message is revoked in the third,
- one screenshot is not valid after all,
- something is crossed out in the image.

From all of this, Claude puts together one neat prompt and gets the job done. That is why, Stepanić concludes, it is always better to work in **larger packages**.

Marko in the meantime confirmed that the message arrived. Stepanić adds that clients often respond on the go, for example with a voice message while driving. Precisely such voice messages are an introduction to the next topic.

sections.subtitle: Glas u tekst gotovo bez greške: Wispr Flow, Soniox i završna dorada s Geminijem
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić prikazuje transkript epizode podcasta na Domovina AI nastao kombinacijom Sonioxa i Geminija
sections.content:
Stepanić ponavlja jednu od glavnih teza predavanja: **ljudi će uvijek pričati**, pa je korištenje AI-ja za širenje istine o onome što ljudi govore dobro mjesto za rad. Današnji modeli za pretvaranje govora u tekst rade vrlo dobro, i za hrvatski jezik.

Publici preporučuje alat **Wispr Flow** i pita tko ga koristi, a tko samo OpenAI-jev **Whisper**. Podsjeća da je Whisper, osobito verzija Whisper Large, bio prvi takav model, kao što je OpenAI s ChatGPT-jem prvi izašao na tržište. Wispr Flow je, prema Stepaniću, prije nekoliko tjedana dobio **280 milijuna dolara investicije u seriji B** od fonda Goodwater, istog fonda koji je uložio i u Photomath.

Zanimljivo je kako je otkrio što Wispr Flow koristi u pozadini, jer to nigdje ne piše:
- Claude mu je napisao **Hammerspoon Lua skripte** koje same klikaju po aplikaciji, pokreću transkripciju i čitaju rezultate,
- Claude je zatim istražio najpopularnije servise za automatsko prepoznavanje govora i izdvojio Speechmatics, Deepgram i Soniox,
- pokrenuo je sva tri i usporedio njihove rezultate s onim što daje Wispr Flow.

Zaključak je bio da Wispr Flow koristi **Soniox**, koji je najjeftiniji, a radi iznimno dobro.

Stepanić hvali i praktičnu stranu: alat se instalira na računalo i automatski bilježi sastanke na Google Meetu ili bilo kojoj drugoj aplikaciji, a na kraju napravi sažetak. Za savršen rezultat preporučuje dodatni korak. **Gemini**, kao multimodalni model, sluša audio datoteku u vremenskim prozorima i prepravlja transkript da bude što vjerniji. Upravo tako radi na **Domovina AI**, a sve je *open source* i može se ponovno koristiti.

Kao primjer prikazuje epizodu podcasta *Argumenti* o Družbi braće hrvatskog zmaja koju je pustio na posebnu obradu. Rezultat ima, kako tvrdi, **ispod 1% greške**. Speechmaticsu pripisuje oko 5% greške, ali i te su greške većinom zanemarive: zamijenjena riječ, krivo veliko ili malo slovo. Gemini ih ispravlja jer zna da se „Hrvatska“ piše velikim slovom i prepoznaje kad su slogovi pogrešno razdvojeni.
sections.subtitle_en: Voice to text almost without error: Wispr Flow, Soniox and final refinement with Gemini
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić shows the transcript of a podcast episode on Domovina AI created by a combination of Soniox and Gemini
sections.content_en:
Stepanić repeats one of the main theses of the lecture: **people will always talk**, so using AI to spread the truth about what people say is a good place to work. Today's models for converting speech to text work very well, also for the Croatian language.

He recommends the tool **Wispr Flow** to the audience and asks who uses it, and who uses only OpenAI's **Whisper**. He reminds that Whisper, especially the Whisper Large version, was the first such model, just as OpenAI was the first to enter the market with ChatGPT. Wispr Flow, according to Stepanić, a few weeks ago received **280 million dollars of investment in Series B** from the Goodwater fund, the same fund that also invested in Photomath.

It is interesting how he discovered what Wispr Flow uses in the background, because that is written nowhere:
- Claude wrote him **Hammerspoon Lua scripts** that click around the application on their own, start transcription, and read the results,
- Claude then researched the most popular services for automatic speech recognition and singled out Speechmatics, Deepgram, and Soniox,
- he ran all three and compared their results with what Wispr Flow gives.

The conclusion was that Wispr Flow uses **Soniox**, which is the cheapest, and works exceptionally well.

Stepanić also praises the practical side: the tool is installed on the computer and automatically records meetings on Google Meet or any other application, and at the end makes a summary. For a perfect result, he recommends an additional step. **Gemini**, as a multimodal model, listens to the audio file in time windows and revises the transcript to be as faithful as possible. That is exactly how it works on **Domovina AI**, and everything is *open source* and can be reused.

As an example, he shows an episode of the podcast *Argumenti* about Družba braće hrvatskog zmaja which he sent for special processing. The result has, as he claims, **under 1% error**. He attributes about 5% error to Speechmatics, but even those errors are mostly negligible: a replaced word, the wrong uppercase or lowercase letter. Gemini corrects them because it knows that „Hrvatska“ is written with a capital letter and recognizes when syllables are incorrectly separated.

sections.subtitle: Tvornica videa, vlastiti blockchain čvor i hrvatska Shopify tema
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić prikazuje projekt Hyperframes u pregledu svojih projekata
sections.content:
Stepanić zatim prolazi kroz pregled svojih projekata, poredanih po kvaliteti, kako je zatražio od Claudea. Prvi je **video tvornica Hyperframes**, koju opisuje kao fenomenalan projekt. Hyperframes je *open source* rješenje tvrtke **HeyGen**, poznate po AI video avatarima. Korisnik opiše video koji želi, a Claude napravi **storyboard** kao da je video ručno montiran.

Slijedi niz manjih i starijih projekata:
- vlastita, u Domovina boje prilagođena verzija *open source* alata za upravljanje **Docker kontejnerima** na serverima,
- **Flutter Firebase Starter** i alat za transkripciju hrvatskog audija,
- **Domovina Blockchain**: na starom MacBooku u uredu u Lomnici pokrenuo je čvor **Gnosis Chaina**,
- **Čitaonica**, koja omogućuje da se podcasti čitaju,
- **automatski YouTube Shorts**, koji uz pomoć FFmpega iz podcasta režu kratke isječke,
- projekt iz listopada 2025. kojim je pokušao napraviti **hrvatsku Shopify temu**, nakon čega su uslijedile i druge teme.

Uz pojedine stavke Stepanić iskreno napominje da „ovo ne funkcionira, ali da se napraviti“. Popis je dosegao osamdesetu stavku, pa se vraća na vrh liste, na najbolje projekte, i poziva publiku da postavlja pitanja o onima koji ih zanimaju.
sections.subtitle_en: Video factory, own blockchain node and Croatian Shopify theme
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić shows the Hyperframes project in an overview of his projects
sections.content_en:
Stepanić then goes through an overview of his projects, sorted by quality, as he requested from Claude. The first is the **video factory Hyperframes**, which he describes as a phenomenal project. Hyperframes is an *open source* solution from the company **HeyGen**, known for AI video avatars. The user describes the video they want, and Claude makes a **storyboard** as if the video were manually edited.

A series of smaller and older projects follows:
- his own version, customized in Domovina colors, of an *open source* tool for managing **Docker containers** on servers,
- **Flutter Firebase Starter** and a tool for the transcription of Croatian audio,
- **Domovina Blockchain**: on an old MacBook in the office in Lomnica he started a node of **Gnosis Chain**,
- **Čitaonica**, which enables podcasts to be read,
- **automatic YouTube Shorts**, which with the help of FFmpeg cut short clips from podcasts,
- a project from October 2025 with which he tried to make a **Croatian Shopify theme**, after which other themes also followed.

Along with individual items, Stepanić honestly notes that „this does not work, but it can be done“. The list reached the eightieth item, so he returns to the top of the list, to the best projects, and invites the audience to ask questions about those that interest them.

sections.subtitle: Ekosustav Domovina AI: od registra podcasta do neporecivog glasovanja i karte Hrvatske
sections.screenshot_description: Prikaz aplikacije za blockchain glasovanje na primjeru Maksimirskog stadiona uz prijavu Certilia mobile ID-om
sections.content:
Na vrhu liste nalaze se projekti iz ekosustava **Domovina AI**. Stepanić napominje da se u pregledu prikazuju stvarne aplikacije, ugrađene putem HTML iframea, a samo su one iza administratorskog sučelja zamijenjene screenshotovima.

**Podcast Registry** nastao je analizom s Claudeom: koji YouTube kanali i playliste sadrže podcaste vrijedne praćenja. Trenutno obuhvaća 49 kanala, a nove će dodavati postupno.

Najviše pažnje privlači **blockchain glasovanje s Certilijom**. Na primjeru Maksimirskog stadiona napravio je aplikaciju u koju se korisnik prijavljuje **Certilia mobile ID-om**, a njegov je glas time **neporeciv**. Uz to je napravio:
- **Pinku**, ideju *peer-to-peer* crowdfunding platforme,
- **Podcasterijum**, Domovina AI na svjetskoj razini; u svijetu je, prema njegovim podacima, oko 500.000 aktivnih podcasta, gotovo pet milijuna ih je dosad nastalo, a doseg se mjeri u milijardama ljudi,
- nacrt *self-custody* walleta, za koji je izradio 17 prototipova.

**GIS Domovina AI** je brza karta Hrvatske. Prvo je obuhvatila sve jedinice lokalne samouprave, a zatim i vrtiće, škole, crkve, katoličke udruge, župe, biskupije, sletne staze aerodroma i igrališta. Stepanić je opisuje ovako: kao što je Domovina AI pojednostavljeni YouTube i Netflix, tako je GIS Domovina AI **pojednostavljeni Google Maps**.

Nabraja i druge projekte:
- **Domovina API**, pozadinski servis koji pokreće sve ostalo,
- **Domovina Studio** za snimanje podcasta, o kojem je govorio ranije,
- *open source* rješenje za **izdavanje fiskaliziranih računa**: korisnik ga pokrene, doda svoje certifikate, generira PDF-ove i ne plaća ništa,
- ideja o „Airbnbu za rođendaonice“,
- **Lopta je okrugla**, pojednostavljena kopija Sofascorea napravljena za vrijeme svjetskog prvenstva; Stepanić je na blockchainu tražio arbitraže i čak ih pronašao, s mogućnošću zarade bez obzira na ishod utakmice, ali ništa od toga nikad nije pustio u rad,
- aplikacija s podacima Državnog izbornog povjerenstva o svim posljednjim izborima,
- **Flutter Certilia**, *open source* Flutter SDK koji Domovina AI koristi za prijavu Certilijom,
- vlastita platforma za ulaznice,
- **Tehnoetika**, rađena za prijatelja koji želi napraviti kopiju Substacka,
- **Domovina Dataset**, repozitorij sa svim podacima,
- **ff.hr (Football Fans)**, s prototipovima brendiranih *self-custody* walleta za sve hrvatske nogometne klubove, uključujući Dinamo.

Stepanić naglašava da u tome nema nikakve prijevare: rješenja su dostupna svakome tko ih želi koristiti.
sections.subtitle_en: The Domovina AI ecosystem: from a podcast registry to non-repudiable voting and a map of Croatia
sections.screenshot_description_en: Display of the blockchain voting application using the example of the Maksimir stadium with login via Certilia mobile ID
sections.content_en:
At the top of the list are projects from the **Domovina AI** ecosystem. Stepanić notes that the overview displays real applications, embedded via an HTML iframe, and only those behind the administrator interface are replaced with screenshots.

**Podcast Registry** was created through analysis with Claude: which YouTube channels and playlists contain podcasts worth following. Currently it includes 49 channels, and he will add new ones gradually.

**Blockchain voting with Certilia** attracts the most attention. Using the example of the Maksimir stadium, he made an application in which the user logs in with **Certilia mobile ID**, and his vote is thus **non-repudiable**. In addition, he made:
- **Pinka**, the idea of a *peer-to-peer* crowdfunding platform,
- **Podcasterijum**, Domovina AI on a global level; in the world, according to his data, there are about 500,000 active podcasts, nearly five million have been created so far, and the reach is measured in billions of people,
- a draft of a *self-custody* wallet, for which he made 17 prototypes.

**GIS Domovina AI** is a fast map of Croatia. First it included all units of local self-government, and then also kindergartens, schools, churches, Catholic associations, parishes, dioceses, airport runways, and playgrounds. Stepanić describes it like this: just as Domovina AI is a simplified YouTube and Netflix, so GIS Domovina AI is a **simplified Google Maps**.

He also lists other projects:
- **Domovina API**, a backend service that powers everything else,
- **Domovina Studio** for recording podcasts, which he spoke about earlier,
- an *open source* solution for **issuing fiscalized receipts**: the user runs it, adds their certificates, generates PDFs, and pays nothing,
- an idea about an „Airbnb for birthday party venues“,
- **Lopta je okrugla**, a simplified copy of Sofascore made during the World Cup; Stepanić searched for arbitrage opportunities on the blockchain and even found them, with the possibility of earning regardless of the match outcome, but he never put any of that into operation,
- an application with data from the Državno izborno povjerenstvo on all the latest elections,
- **Flutter Certilia**, an *open source* Flutter SDK that Domovina AI uses for login with Certilia,
- his own ticketing platform,
- **Tehnoetika**, made for a friend who wants to make a copy of Substack,
- **Domovina Dataset**, a repository with all the data,
- **ff.hr (Football Fans)**, with prototypes of branded *self-custody* wallets for all Croatian football clubs, including Dinamo.

Stepanić emphasizes that there is no fraud in this: the solutions are available to anyone who wants to use them.

sections.subtitle: HEP-ovi podaci, zakoni, računi za udruge i banka koja javlja uplatu
sections.screenshot_description: Matija Stepanić opisuje FIRA Forms Connector rađen za katoličku udrugu Prilika za susret
sections.content:
Drugi dio pregleda donosi alate za praktične probleme. Prvi omogućuje **uvoz podataka iz HEP-ovih sustava**, HEP Moja mreža, HEP Moj račun i HEP Moja opskrba, u nekoliko klikova. Flutter aplikacija na iOS-u i Androidu pokrene WebView, doda mu potrebne funkcije i, nakon autorizacije Certilijom, preuzme podatke. Ista je mogućnost dostupna na **omm.domovina.ai**, gdje se može očitati stanje vlastitog brojila.

Stepanić prikazuje i internu aplikaciju koja prati obradu sadržaja korak po korak, na primjeru posljednje objavljene epizode podcasta *Argumenti* o Družbi braće hrvatskog zmaja. Spominje i projekt rađen za **udrugu Magnus**. **Zakoni Domovina AI** sadrže sve zakone iz Narodnih novina preuzete do 2022., a cilj je napraviti bazu za pretraživanje svega.

Posebno ističe **FIRA Forms Connector**, napravljen za katoličku udrugu **Prilika za susret**. Udruga koristi FIRU za izdavanje fiskaliziranih računa, a prijave prima putem Google Formsa. Podaci odlaze u Google Sheets. Za međunarodni susret prijavilo se više od 300 ljudi. Stepanić je preko **Google Apps Scripta** dodao jedan gumb u tablicu: klik i potvrda pozovu FIRA API, račun se izda, a sudionik ga dobije mailom. Kod je dostupan na GitHubu.

Slijede projekti vezani uz novac i komunikaciju:
- **Od danas do sutra**, jednostavan video napravljen s Hyperframesom; na oddsdomovina.ai mogu se renderirati mali videi sa zanimljivim podacima,
- **mpt.hr**, servis na kojem trenutno radi; Stepanić ga opisuje kao ekvivalent RevenueCata za plaćanja unutar aplikacija, odnosno kao orkestrator za detekciju plaćanja s Moneriumovim reguliranim eurima,
- **Stranke Domovina AI**, pregled svih političkih stranaka,
- **Android telefon kao SMS gateway**: telefon javlja vašem servisu kad stigne SMS, a može poslužiti i za verifikaciju broja telefona,
- skripte za automatsko objavljivanje na LinkedInu,
- **radar javne nabave**, koji svakodnevno pretražuje Elektronički oglasnik javne nabave i traži natječaje na koje bi se mogao javiti kao IT izvođač.
sections.subtitle_en: HEP data, laws, invoices for associations and a bank that notifies of payment
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matija Stepanić describes the FIRA Forms Connector made for the Catholic association Prilika za susret
sections.content_en:
The second part of the overview brings tools for practical problems. The first enables **importing data from HEP systems**, HEP Moja mreža, HEP Moj račun and HEP Moja opskrba, in a few clicks. A Flutter application on iOS and Android launches a WebView, adds the necessary functions to it and, after authorization with Certilia, downloads the data. The same option is available at **omm.domovina.ai**, where the status of one's own meter can be read.

Stepanić also shows an internal application that tracks content processing step by step, using the example of the last published episode of the podcast *Argumenti* about Družba braće hrvatskog zmaja. He also mentions a project made for **udruga Magnus**. **Zakoni Domovina AI** contains all laws from Narodne novine retrieved up to 2022, and the goal is to create a database for searching everything.

He particularly highlights **FIRA Forms Connector**, made for the Catholic association **Prilika za susret**. The association uses FIRA for issuing fiscalized invoices, and receives applications via Google Forms. The data goes to Google Sheets. For the international meeting, more than 300 people registered. Stepanić added one button to the spreadsheet via **Google Apps Script**: a click and confirmation call the FIRA API, the invoice is issued, and the participant receives it by email. The code is available on GitHub.

Projects related to money and communication follow:
- **Od danas do sutra**, a simple video made with Hyperframes; on oddsdomovina.ai small videos with interesting data can be rendered,
- **mpt.hr**, a service he is currently working on; Stepanić describes it as the equivalent of RevenueCat for in-app payments, that is, as an orchestrator for payment detection with Monerium's regulated euros,
- **Stranke Domovina AI**, an overview of all political parties,
- **Android phone as an SMS gateway**: the phone notifies your service when an SMS arrives, and it can also serve for phone number verification,
- scripts for automatic publishing on LinkedIn,
- **public procurement radar**, which daily searches the Elektronički oglasnik javne nabave and looks for tenders for which he could apply as an IT contractor.

sections.subtitle: Statistika vektorske baze, besplatni Open Diagram i 526 praćenih kanala
sections.screenshot_description: Na ekranu stats.domovina.ai s vizualizacijom vektorske baze i statistikama epizoda i govornika
sections.content:
Završni dio pregleda otvara **stats.domovina.ai**, aplikacija koja vizualizira vektorsku bazu Domovina AI. Prikazuje kretanje broja epizoda po mjesecima i najzastupljenije govornike. Jedan podatak izmamio je reakciju publike: **osoba koja se u podcastima najčešće spominje je Isus**. Uz to su tu i **Crkve Domovina AI**, sve crkve na jednom mjestu, zajedno s biskupijama.

**Open Diagram** je Stepanićeva *open source* kopija alata dbdiagram.io, napravljena jer mu je trebala za projekt. Kad s lijeve strane unese DBML, dobije vizualizaciju baze podataka. Za originalni alat, koji ocjenjuje vrlo dobrim, posljednjih je godina plaćao oko 92 eura godišnje, „međutim, došao je AI koji može skopirati“.

Slijede ostali alati:
- **Klubovi Domovina AI**, s kontaktima svih hrvatskih nogometnih klubova prikupljenima iz Sofascorea, HNS Semafora, registra udruga i još jednog izvora navedenog u podnožju stranice,
- **Podcast Domovina AI**, koji putem YouTube API-ja svakodnevno prati nove epizode; dnevno stiže 20 do 22 podcasta, a prati se oko **526 kanala**,
- aplikacija za čitanje HEP-ovih podataka koja generira PDF izvještaj o potrošnji, s ciljem automatskih ponuda za elektrane,
- **Podcasterijum registrar** s gotovo pet milijuna podcasta, uglavnom iz baze Podscan FM,
- kronološki pregled medijskog izvještavanja o temi **Chat Control**, koji je Claude složio s portala,
- ***open source* bankovni push gateway**: Android aplikacija prepoznaje push obavijest mobilnog bankarstva, primjerice HPB-a, o novoj uplati i javlja je vašem servisu; Monerium takav fintech API već ima, ali domaće banke nemaju, a ovako je moguća detekcija uplata u stvarnom vremenu,
- **Domovina storage** za pohranu podataka,
- AI tim od **pet Claude Code instanci koje međusobno komuniciraju**,
- osobni web **itok.hr**,
- **Modrić Lottery**, Solana dApp vezan uz Modrić token, kojeg je Stepanić vlasnik,
- **Media Kit** s generiranim logotipovima,
- **Domovina Cutter**, koji automatski izreže odabrani dio podcasta za slanje na WhatsApp,
- interni alat za praćenje obilježavanja 50 godina župe u Lomnici.

Stepanić zaključuje pregled i otvara prostor za pitanja publike.
sections.subtitle_en: Vector database statistics, free Open Diagram and 526 tracked channels
sections.screenshot_description_en: On the screen stats.domovina.ai with a visualization of the vector database and statistics of episodes and speakers
sections.content_en:
The final part of the overview opens **stats.domovina.ai**, an application that visualizes the Domovina AI vector database. It shows the trend in the number of episodes by month and the most represented speakers. One piece of data drew a reaction from the audience: **the person most frequently mentioned in podcasts is Jesus**. In addition, there is also **Crkve Domovina AI**, all churches in one place, together with dioceses.

**Open Diagram** is Stepanić's *open source* copy of the dbdiagram.io tool, made because he needed it for a project. When he enters DBML on the left side, he gets a visualization of the database. For the original tool, which he rates as very good, in recent years he paid about 92 euros a year, „however, AI came that can copy it“.

The other tools follow:
- **Klubovi Domovina AI**, with contacts of all Croatian football clubs gathered from Sofascore, HNS Semafor, the register of associations, and one more source listed in the footer of the page,
- **Podcast Domovina AI**, which tracks new episodes daily via the YouTube API; 20 to 22 podcasts arrive daily, and about **526 channels** are tracked,
- an application for reading HEP data that generates a PDF report on consumption, with the goal of automatic offers for power plants,
- **Podcasterijum registrar** with almost five million podcasts, mostly from the Podscan FM database,
- a chronological overview of media reporting on the topic of **Chat Control**, which Claude assembled from portals,
- ***open source* banking push gateway**: an Android application recognizes a mobile banking push notification, for example from HPB, about a new payment and reports it to your service; Monerium already has such a fintech API, but domestic banks do not, and in this way real-time payment detection is possible,
- **Domovina storage** for data storage,
- an AI team of **five Claude Code instances that communicate with each other**,
- personal website **itok.hr**,
- **Modrić Lottery**, a Solana dApp tied to the Modrić token, of which Stepanić is the owner,
- **Media Kit** with generated logos,
- **Domovina Cutter**, which automatically cuts out the selected part of a podcast for sending on WhatsApp,
- an internal tool for tracking the commemoration of 50 years of the parish in Lomnica.

Stepanić concludes the overview and opens space for questions from the audience.
